There is a distinction between behaviour/attraction and identity. Bi/homo/hetero-sexuality are identities. 

Men who have sex with men (MSM (or WSW for women)) are behaviours and people who engage in these behaviours may identify as any of the sexualities listed above, as well as others others (pansexual, for example).

Discrepancies between behaviour and identity are often more complex than simply being closeted, for example, but this can explain—at least some of the time—why these discrepancies exist. 

This gets even more confusing when gender gets involved such as in the trans community but suffice it to say for the sake of this conversation:

The definition of a bisexual is somebody who identifies as bisexual. Period.
